resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1958 is the year the Round Pass house was moved onto the butte, the first structure there. The current R-6 cab dates to 1964 according to the register, Forest Lookouts and Cheryl Hill. Firelookout.com's 1958 date for the R-6 cab is not matched by the others.

notes_for_editor: Elevation conflict, not resolved: the register gives 7,180 ft (2,188 m), which matches the record's elevation_m; firelookout.com and Cheryl Hill give 7,234 ft (about 2,205 m). Origin site is disputed: the Round Pass record (US 1040) gives 7,462 ft at the pass, while Cheryl Hill places the earlier cabin on Round Mountain, also 7,462 ft. The 2020 Brattain Fire is mentioned only by the 2024 staffer; the fire itself was not checked, and a search turned up Paisley news reports that were not read. Staffing and access rest on a July 2024 visit and an undated firelookout.com page; nothing newer was found. Weebly page read only in targeted lines.
